title: CultNet Error Message
description: R-X (docs/cultnet-selection-cut.md, fix batch 4): CultNetErrorMessage is a MessagePack-CSharp map-mode object, so every declared key is written on the wire, nil included - routingHint, code and details are `required` here the same as cultnet.raw-document-header.schema.json's nullable fields, not optional just because a given refusal leaves them null.

routingHint.description: Optional shard routing detail for an authority failure. Null for every selection/cursor refusal code (R-N).

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code (R-N). Additive: a v0 peer that does not know this field ignores it.

details.description: Code-specific structured detail (R-N). Every field is populated only for the code that defines it; the others are null, not omitted.

field.description: selection_invalid: the selection field that failed.

value.description: selection_invalid: the offending value, when there is one string worth naming.

asOf.description: cursor_stale: the cursor's own minted asOf.

current.description: cursor_stale: the answering server's current asOf.
